name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/site-styles
description: This site's application CSS: the stack declaration, then v4's five ITCSS tiers under the site layer, and the site's self-hosted fonts. A site plugin: a repo-only package, never published (private), loaded by package name like every other plugin of ours. See CONTEXT.md.
//files: Repo-only (private), so never packed or published; files, license, publishConfig and repository are here because the package contract is one shape for every plugin of ours (#98).
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits, as every plugin of ours does: the package contract (the package-contract repo guard, #98) holds a site plugin to the same shape as a published one. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//devDependencies: Build-time only. Sass compiles the tiers and esbuild inlines the result into dist/index.js, which imports nothing at run time; @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes dist/index.d.ts (build.mjs).

quartz.name: site-styles
quartz.//defaultOrder: Below every other plugin, so the stack declaration is the first named-layer statement after core's index.css (ADR-0003, site-plugin amendment).
